newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian electricity consumption up 4.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Italian electricity consumption up 4.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Italian electricity consumption rose a seasonally and calendar adjusted 4.3 percent in April compared to the same month last year, utility company Enel said on Monday.
Enel said some 22 billion kWh of electricity was used last month. On an unadjusted basis, consumption rose 7.2 percent year on year.
In the first four months of 1997 consumption rose an adjusted 1.4 percent, Enel said. On an unadjusted basis consumption was flat in the same period.
Electricity demand was boosted in April by the industrial sector after a consumption fall in the previous month, Enel said.
Net national production in April was 18.8 billion kWh, up 7.8 percent on the previous year.
